title: Company OS manifest
description: The single file describing your company: one entry per project, plus satellites that are tracked but have no page of their own.

id.description: Stable identifier. Also the avatar filename (<id>.webp) and the governance profile key.

dir.description: Directory relative to config.root. Its package.json supplies the command surface.

class.description: Short category shown under the title, e.g. 'Production studio'.

role.description: What this project is responsible for, and what it deliberately is not.

badge.description: Short label on the desk monitor, e.g. 'SCAN'.

station.description: Desk name shown under the title.

style.description: CSS-figure variant, used when no mascot image is configured.

ingress.description: What this project consumes. Entries containing filesystem paths are dropped from any public projection.

nodes.description: Pipeline stages, rendered left to right.

cmd.description: The command this stage runs. Matched against package.json scripts to mark them wired/scheduled.

tasks.description: Scheduler task names. Their live state is resolved at build time.

scriptNotes.description: Optional one-line notes keyed by npm script name.

hasOwnDashboard.description: This project maintains its own index.html. The generator will not overwrite it, and writes ops-commands.html alongside instead.

statusFile.description: Override the per-project status file path (default: config.projectStatusFile).

dir.description: Set this to surface the satellite's npm commands on the floor.
